title: CHANGE OF GUARD CEREMONY TO take place from 0730 AM to 0830 am from this Saturday
body_text:
The Change of Guard Ceremony, which takes place every Saturday at the Forecourt of Rashtrapati Bhavan, will shift to a new timing, i.e., from 0730 a.m. to 0830 a.m. from this Saturday (October 10, 2026).
More details at https://visit.rashtrapatibhavan.gov.in/
***
MJPS/SS/PRK
